input.prompt: Hand-drawn coloured-pencil animation on cream drawing paper, keeping exactly the same drawing style, pencil strokes, hatching and paper texture in every frame. Static locked-off camera, chest-up framing stays exactly as in the first frame. A silent, still moment at dusk: the young man in the flat cap with his acoustic guitar stands quietly, listening to music, breathing gently. His lips stay gently closed the whole time: he never speaks, never sings, never opens his mouth. His eyes soften and a small closed-mouth smile slowly forms at the corners of his lips. His hands rest still on the guitar; he does not play. His face, hair and clothes stay exactly as drawn. The dusk light slowly warms a little. Minimal, subtle motion only; no camera movement, no zoom, no new people, no text.
